text:
matt: Quick prototype dropped into the Console analytics sandbox — per-route views now surface per-model-variant telemetry. Need input on how saved queries/filters should behave (org-level vs route-level vs model-level) and the UX for rollouts/quotas.

anya: Nice! Two quick asks: 1) show quota burn rate (tokens/min) in the header, 2) saved queries should default to "route" but give an easy global toggle. :thumbsup:

dina: Agreed on defaulting to route. Adding: when saving a filter, prompt for scope with three radio options: "This route only", "All routes for this model", "Organization-wide". Keep names short and show affected routes count.

lee: Also important to show rollout metadata inline (canary percent, ramp schedule) and active fallback policies. If a variant is in fallback mode, mark it with a warning pill.

sam: Backend note — we'll need variant_id indexed in the metrics store to get per-variant p50/p95 efficiently. Saved-query objects need: filter blob, scope enum, owner, pinned boolean. If scope = "model", we should expand to affected routes at query time (or cache expansion).

matt: For the UI saving flow: quick-save (ctrl+s) should default to route-scope. "Save as..." opens modal with scope radios and optional team tag. Also thinking about a small "apply to similar routes" checkbox when scope=model.

anya: Modal is good — UX: show a preview of the first 3 routes that will be included when choosing model-scope. Helps avoid surprises.

sam: Also note quota-aware filters: if a saved filter references a model with no quota assigned, surface "no quota" so SRE/owner can act.

matt: Example filter payload (for backend folks):
```
model.id: "redwood-7b"
route.id: "payments-checkout"
variant: "quantized-8bit-v2"
metrics: ["p50_latency","token_cost"]
time: last_7d
```

dina: I'll mock the modal + header chips and post a Figma link later today — will include the preview rows and quota badge. FYI: product meeting at 3pm to finalize wording.

deploy-bot: analytics-filter-service v1.3.2 deployed to staging :rocket:

lee: One last thought — saved queries should respect permissions: team-scoped queries visible only to team members unless explicitly shared.

matt: Perfect. Thanks all — @dina once you post mocks I'll move this to a small RFC with scope/acceptance criteria.
